task: Add a frontend-only Clone action to Data Sources (list + details) that opens the create form prefilled from an existing Data Source and saves a new independent one.

key_reasoning.reason: Routing/constants, DataSourceActions, DataSourceDetails, a clone page, plus the shared DataSourceForm / useEditPopupForm / useCreateIndex where `index` doubles as the edit-mode switch in about 10 places; a non-edit prefill path is needed.

Closest precedent is assistant/workflow clone (route + GET + strip identity + reuse create), but it does not cover secret handling: provider SECRET fields come back masked and the create path would persist the mask, so they must be blanked. Other traps: wrongly wiring Save as an update of the source, OAuth-only SharePoint token, Bedrock hidden, and thin test coverage on form prefill.
About 6-9 UI source files modified plus 1-2 new (clone page, tests) across pages, constants, router and form hooks; no backend files.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: nearest existing clone pattern does not cover secret handling (masked provider secrets).
